title: JailPO: A Novel Black-box Jailbreak Framework via Preference Optimization against Aligned LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical development of a jailbreak framework designed to bypass LLM safety alignments. While it tests the generation of 'harmful content' (e.g., instructions for making a bomb or hate speech), the study is oriented toward security and robustness testing rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
